name: raman-turnover-benchmark
description: Code and evaluation records for Resolving the Raman crystallite size turnover in nanocrystalline graphite with a synthetic benchmark (R. J. York, preprint v2.0, 2026-09-05). The disorder ratio I(D)/I(G) of carbon Raman spectra is not invertible: it rises as 1/La to a turnover near 20 Å and falls as La2 beyond it. The repository holds the generator of a deterministic synthetic corpus built on that forward model (3,400 spectra at 325, 514 and 633 nm with planted acquisition failures; seed 3407), the five benchmark tasks, the physics baseline and learned inversion pipelines scored on it, the probes, the release-gate verifier, and an append-only Ed25519 ledger tool. All results are modelled: they are outputs of a declared forward model and make no claim about physical films. Release v2.0 pins the code at the state re-derived on three independent environments (macOS pinned, Linux sandbox, GitHub Actions pinned) with the release gates reporting PASS, adds a test suite and a continuous re-derivation workflow, and documents the scikit-learn-version drift of the learned model. The corpus, per-row metadata and evaluation records are deposited separately (data record, CC BY 4.0); the preprint PDF is attached to this release.
